subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II package, bridge letter & intake templates
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@northwindhealth.com>, procurement@northwindhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II package, bridge letter & intake templates

Hi Ava / Procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. To keep the integration and procurement track moving, can you share the following items related to your SOC 2 Type II request for Redwood Inference (deal NW-2314)? I put the minimum asks below to avoid chasing down too many artifacts up-front.

Minimum package (preferred first pass):
- Most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or read-only link to your portal (clearaudit/other).
- Bridge letter if the report's audit period does not fully cover our contract start date (see note below).
- Evidence transfer contact (name + email + preferred transfer method: SFTP / SharePoint / Box / secure link).
- A contact for any short clarifying Qs from our auditor (name + email + phone).

If you can provide the report and bridge letter (if applicable) via SFTP or a secure Share Drive link that would be ideal — we have an intake folder ready. I attached a one-page SOC2_TypeII_Request_Form.pdf that you can fill quickly and return.

Quick clarification on bridge letters/audit period: if your most recent Type II report ends before our expected go-live or contract start, a bridge letter is commonly requested to attest that controls remained in place from the report end date to a stated date. If your report covers the relevant audit window (we're targeting a contract start of 2027-05-15), a bridge letter may not be required. If you're unsure, please share the report and we'll advise.

Templates & canned replies you can use (attached as well):
- Short note to security/audit team to request report (one-click copy): "Can you share our latest SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter for the period ending YYYY-MM-DD? Prefer SFTP: sftp://files.redwood.ai/northwind-inbound."
- If you prefer we work with your procurement/legal team directly, cc procurement@redwoodhealth.com and we'll coordinate.

Next steps: once you share the report (or portal link) we'll route to our compliance lead (Marissa) and confirm whether additional evidence or a bridge letter is needed.

If helpful I can also provide a secure upload link (pre-signed) or accept DocuSign for the bridge letter.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Request_Form.pdf

From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@northwindhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northwindhealth.com, auditor@clearaudit.com
Date: 2027-04-29T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II package, bridge letter & intake templates

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear list. We have the most recent Type II report (period: 2026-06-01 to 2027-02-28). That ends a bit before your planned start (2027-05-15); our security team typically provides a bridge letter for scenarios like this.

A few quick Qs from procurement:
- Preferred transfer method: we can SFTP into the location you provided, or upload an encrypted ZIP to our SharePoint and share a link. Which do you prefer?
- Required metadata on the intake form: is it OK to include our internal auditor contact (same as above) and a short line about data residency?

Cc-ing our auditor (auditor@clearaudit.com) so they have visibility — they may provide a standard bridge letter template. We'll target sending the report and a draft bridge letter by EOD 2027-04-30.

Best,
Ava Collins
Head of Procurement | Northwind Health
ava.collins@northwindhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@northwindhealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, auditor@clearaudit.com
Date: 2027-04-29T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II package, bridge letter & intake templates

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping in your auditor. A few operational notes from Redwood compliance so we can triage quickly when the package arrives:

1) Transfer method: SFTP to sftp://files.redwood.ai/northwind-inbound is preferred. We monitor that inbound folder and will move received files to our secure evidence vault. If you must use SharePoint, please send a read-only link and set expiration to at most 30 days; include the account 'redwood-compliance@redwood.ai' on the share.

2) Required metadata on the intake form:
- Report period start/end
- Name of the audit firm
- Whether the report includes subservice organizations (and if so, which ones)
- Contact for follow-up questions (name/email/phone)

3) Bridge letter guidance:
- If your report ends 2027-02-28 and our target contract date is 2027-05-15, a bridge letter that attests controls were in place to at least 2027-05-15 is sufficient.
- If your auditor prefers to issue a dated attestation to a specific date, that is fine; we just need it signed and on company letterhead.

Canned reply templates you can forward to security/audit (copy/paste):

A) Request to audit team (SFTP preferred)"
Hi Security/Audit team,

Please share our latest SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2026-06-01 to 2027-02-28) and a bridge letter covering through 2027-05-15 if available. Upload to SFTP: sftp://files.redwood.ai/northwind-inbound and include a completed intake form (Report period, audit firm, subservice orgs, follow-up contact).

Thanks,
[Name]

B) Bridge letter accept template (procurement to vendor)"
Redwood Inference requires a bridge letter when a SOC 2 Type II report does not cover the contract start date. A short attestation on letterhead signed by the engagement partner is acceptable. Please indicate the date through which controls are attested.

We will treat the bridge letter as an addendum to the report for procurement review.

Once the report and bridge letter are uploaded, please reply to this thread so we can confirm receipt and next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
